name: Catherine Grub

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To Gottlieb Hipp (1752-1839); his will is in Northampton Will Book 6 pp.18-19

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Catharina a birth date of 25 Nov 1755 in Williams Twp, her marriage to Gottlieb Hipp on 21 Jan 1777, and her death on 19 Mar 1836, with burial at St John's Lutheran, Easton (S1). Gottlieb Hipp's will is in Northampton Will Book 6 pp.18-19.
